description:
One typed row of language_metrics.csv, as produced by validation.artifact_io.strict_csv. Column types were derived from preserved Artifact 1.3 and 1.4 runs rather than assumed; see validation/scripts/derive_tabular_schemas.py. This artifact is a checked projection of authoritative repository results, not an independent measurement authority.

Artifact Schema 1.7.0: `subject_key` is the logical join key for this row. The locator column becomes nullable because a local subject has no remote URL — a key that is sometimes absent was never a key.

Artifact Schema 1.11.0 adds the benchmark qualification projection. Repository representativeness and benchmark admission are dimensions SEPARATE from measurement completeness: `metric_status` keeps its exact 1.10 meaning and is neither redefined nor derived from any column added here. Every qualification cell is a checked projection of the authoritative `benchmark_qualification.json`; none is an independent authority. In `qualification_mode=not_requested` the qualification cells are explicit nulls with eligibility false, and the measurement cells are byte-identical to what 1.10 produced.

analysis_scope_hash.description: Identity of the exact measured source scope, copied from the authoritative repository result. Part of the qualification primary binding. Never a repository coverage or representativeness proof.

analysis_scope_hash_version.description: Construction version of `analysis_scope_hash`. Part of the primary binding: two scope hashes built by different constructions are not comparable identities.

benchmark_usability.description: DERIVED admission verdict. Never read from registry input. `partial_but_usable` says nothing about repository scope, so no consumer may infer scope from this column alone.

classes_structs.description: Empty cells decode to null and must not be read as zero.

lines_of_code.description: Empty cells decode to null and must not be read as zero.

methods_functions.description: Empty cells decode to null and must not be read as zero.

qualification_profile.description: Qualification profile the decision was made under. A representativeness verdict is only meaningful relative to the question its profile asks.

qualification_record_id.description: Stable identifier of the accepted registry record this projection came from.

qualification_status.description: `adjudicated` when an exact registry match supplied an accepted human/forensic decision; `unresolved` when evidence was absent, stale or identity-mismatched; `not_requested` in generic mode. `unresolved` never defaults to ADEQUATE.

repository_level_comparison_eligible.description: STRICTLY DERIVED. True only for an adjudicated ADEQUATE record with complete measurement, no manual restriction, and derived `repository_level_usable`. Never supplied by registry input. False in generic mode and for every historical unqualified run.

repository_representativeness.description: Whether the selected supported scope adequately represents first-party application code for the declared profile. INDEPENDENT of `metric_status`: a complete measurement of a non-representative scope is still complete.

repository_url.description: Source/origin locator. **Nullable and no longer the identity key** — a local subject may have no origin. Use `subject_key` for joins.

representativeness_reason_codes.description: Stable semantic reason codes for the representativeness verdict, canonical JSON list encoding. These are comparison keys; the accompanying basis text is not.

source_files.description: Empty cells decode to null and must not be read as zero.

source_files_entity_parsed.description: Empty cells decode to null and must not be read as zero.

source_files_failed_parse.description: Empty cells decode to null and must not be read as zero.

source_files_failed_read.description: Empty cells decode to null and must not be read as zero.

source_files_loc_analyzed.description: Empty cells decode to null and must not be read as zero.

source_files_oversized.description: Empty cells decode to null and must not be read as zero.

source_files_partial_parse.description: Empty cells decode to null and must not be read as zero.

source_files_readable.description: Empty cells decode to null and must not be read as zero.

source_files_recovered_parse.description: Empty cells decode to null and must not be read as zero.

subject_key.description: Logical subject identity. The join key across runs, revisions and source modes. Never a content hash.

usability_reason_codes.description: Stable semantic reason codes for the usability verdict, canonical JSON list encoding.
